_comment:
ページ「AI松井社長と 話す 準備を しよう」で **松井社長が 出る** 4枚。looks は content/characters/matsui.json から 逐語で 写す。松井社長は **本人の 参考写真も 参照に 渡す**（2026-08-25 の 指定）。学生は g1、絵柄は 同じ ページの j1 に そろえる。

**negative から「悲しい 顔の 禁止」を 外して ある**（skill §7.2 の t25_trouble と 同じ 扱い）。A と B の 分かれ道は「社長が どう 感じたか」その ものなので、両方 おだやかに 描くと **選ばせる 意味が 消える**。外したのは 悲しさ までで、怒り・こわい 顔は 禁じた ままに して ある。
style: Style: warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, soft cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, warm cream walls with sky-blue and coral accents, tidy contemporary offices with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions and warm friendly faces. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Screens, papers, whiteboards, books and signs are blank or show only soft abstract shapes and simple pictures. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no speech balloons.
negative: Never: flat vector icon art, pictograms, infographic diagrams, symbols floating on an empty background, wide empty margins, minimalist clip-art, 3D render, photo realism, harsh gradients, readable letters or numbers, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, angry or frightening faces, tears, shouting, extra fingers or limbs, robots, mascots. Keep every referenced character's face, hair and clothing exactly as in their model sheet — no costume changes, no age changes.

scenes.title: A 前のめりで 話す 学生（社長の 目が ハート）
scenes.output: Output: one landscape illustration, 1536x1024. Close view — the two people fill the frame edge to edge.
scenes.scene: Scene: a bright meeting corner of a modern office. On the LEFT sits THE STUDENT — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length straight dark hair and a warm coral-orange blouse; keep her face, hair and blouse exactly the same as in the third reference image. She leans far forward over the small table, both hands open and lifted, eyes bright, clearly in the middle of saying something she loves. On the RIGHT sits MATSUI, the company president from the first two reference images — a Japanese man in his forties, ordinary build with normal shoulders and a normal waist, black hair with volume on top and a soft fringe, fair skin, gently rounded cheeks, narrow gentle eyes, navy blazer worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, no tie, no glasses. He is delighted: he leans in toward her, hands clasped, mouth open in a warm happy smile, and BOTH OF HIS EYES ARE DRAWN AS PINK CARTOON HEARTS in place of his pupils — the classic manga way of showing he is charmed. The hearts are only inside his eyes; nothing floats in the air. Warm daylight, a plant and two mugs on the table.

scenes.title: B 関心が なさそうな 学生（社長は 悲しそう）
scenes.output: Output: one landscape illustration, 1536x1024. Close view — the two people fill the frame edge to edge.
scenes.scene: Scene: the same bright meeting corner of the same modern office, same table, same plant and mugs. On the LEFT sits THE STUDENT — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length straight dark hair and a warm coral-orange blouse; keep her face, hair and blouse exactly the same as in the third reference image. She sits back in her chair with her shoulders low and her hands resting flat on the table, looking away past the president with a flat, uninterested expression — polite but with nothing to say. On the RIGHT sits MATSUI, the company president from the first two reference images — a Japanese man in his forties, ordinary build with normal shoulders and a normal waist, black hair with volume on top and a soft fringe, fair skin, gently rounded cheeks, narrow gentle eyes, navy blazer worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, no tie, no glasses. He is quietly disappointed: his eyebrows tilt up in the middle, his mouth is a small downward curve, one hand rests on the table and his shoulders have dropped a little. He is gently sad, never angry and never crying. Same warm daylight, but the mood is quiet.

scenes.title: 5 松井社長に 何を 聞きたい？（手を 挙げて 質問する）
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Close view — the subject fills the frame edge to edge.
scenes.scene: Scene: the same bright office meeting corner. THE STUDENT — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length straight dark hair and a warm coral-orange blouse; keep her face, hair and blouse exactly the same as in the third reference image — sits at the table and RAISES ONE HAND STRAIGHT UP beside her head, fingers together, with a bright eager expression, asking a question. Seen slightly from her side so both people are visible. Across the table MATSUI, the company president from the first two reference images — a Japanese man in his forties, ordinary build, black hair with volume on top and a soft fringe, navy blazer worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, no tie, no glasses — turns toward her with a warm, interested smile and an open hand, ready to answer. An open notebook and a mug on the table, a plant by the window.

scenes.title: くらべ・後 松井社長に 話す こと（調べた こと＋自分の 考え）
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Close view — the subject fills the frame edge to edge.
scenes.scene: Scene: the same bright office meeting corner. THE STUDENT — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length straight dark hair and a warm coral-orange blouse; keep her face, hair and blouse exactly the same as in the third reference image — sits at the table with one hand pressed lightly to her own chest and the other open toward the president, telling him what she herself thinks. Her notebook lies closed beside her: she is not reading from it. Across the table MATSUI, the company president from the first two reference images — a Japanese man in his forties, ordinary build, black hair with volume on top and a soft fringe, navy blazer worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, no tie, no glasses — listens with his head tilted slightly, nodding, a warm attentive smile. Warm daylight, a plant and two mugs.
